title: Critical parts of almost every fiber are Hᵏ-null (co-area formula with A = C)
statement: Assume the frozen co-area formula CoareaFormula (Simon 6.3/6.6). Let N, m, k ∈ ℕ with k ≥ 1, M ⊆ ℝᴺ an (m+k)-dimensional C¹ Simon submanifold, U ⊆ ℝᴺ open with M ⊆ U, f : ℝᴺ → ℝᵐ of class C¹ on U, and suppose M is a measurable set and x ↦ coareaJacobian M f x is continuous on M. Then for Lebesgue-a.e. y ∈ ℝᵐ, μHE[k](M ∩ f⁻¹{y} ∩ {x : coareaJacobian M f x = 0}) = 0.
lean_statement: CoareaFormula → ∀ (N m k : ℕ) (M U : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m), 0 < k → Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn (m + k)) 1 M → IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U → MeasurableSet M → ContinuousOn (coareaJacobian M f) M → ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Rn m)), μHE[k] (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {y} ∩ {x | coareaJacobian M f x = 0}) = 0
